## Speaker levels, right on Listen
Adjust your left and right speakers separately beside the shared volume. A compatible Wi-Fi speaker and added speakers have their relative level controls in the same place. More controls opens the full balance panel.
- Changing one main speaker preserves the other speaker's native level. The louder main speaker sets the shared volume, and room speakers follow it with their saved offset. - Keyboard volume and mute still control the group. Existing speaker setup, tone, room profiles and timing are retained. - Speaker adjustments are held during calls, video and room tuning. - Reopening Onda after closing its window brings Listen back without restarting playback.
You can use Onda on the Mac without an iPhone: select outputs, adjust levels, bass and treble, and use estimated/manual timing. New measured acoustic timing and room EQ need the iPhone companion and the supported Studio Display setup. The iPhone companion is separate and is not included in this Mac download.
## Install and update
Universal Apple silicon and Intel download for macOS 14 or later; Spotify sharing needs macOS 14.2. Signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple and stapled. The bundled audio driver is unchanged; these controls do not require a driver update.
Beta 113 and 114 users receive this through Onda's signed automatic-update feed. Updates download quietly and install on normal quit. You can also choose Check for Updates in Settings. Calls, video and tuning postpone checks; a deferred manual restart requires a fresh click when idle. Beta 112 or earlier needs one manual installation to enable automatic updates.
This is a public beta. Generic speaker groups use estimated/manual timing; measured EQ and acoustic sync still require the supported Studio Display/Sonos topology.
## Verification
The source test run passed 268 Swift tests with zero failures and five environment-dependent skips; 26 final focused tests passed. Live checks covered individual speaker controls, shared volume, retained settings and window reopening during playback. Four publication-verifier regressions pass with Python optimizations enabled. Release validation checks both architectures, signatures, notarization, stapled tickets and the actual public download before updating the signed feed. No new acoustic calibration or live call test was performed for this UI-only release.
